items.stimulus: וישכחו בני־ישראל את־יהוה אלהיהם וימכר אותם ביד מלך מואב
options: Jacob said to Esau, First sell me thy birthright; and he sold him his birthright.
Let us make a covenant, I and thou, and it shall be for a witness between me and thee.
And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth, and all flesh expired that moved upon the earth, among birds and cattle, and all mankind.
And the Israelites forgot Yahweh their God and he sold them into the hand of the king of Moab.
items.answer: And the Israelites forgot Yahweh their God and he sold them into the hand of the king of Moab.

items.stimulus: וימלך־שם שבע שנים וששה חדשים ושלשים ושלש שנה מלך בירושלם
options: In the thirty-seventh year, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh (day) of the month, the king of Babylon lifted up the head of the king of Judah out of the prison-house.
And it came to pass in the six hundred and first year of his life, in the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.
And five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand.
And he reigned there seven years and six months, and thirty-three years he reigned in Jerusalem.
items.answer: And he reigned there seven years and six months, and thirty-three years he reigned in Jerusalem.
